info.name: Nginx version detect
author: philippedelteil
daffainfo
info.description: Some nginx servers have the version on the response header. Useful when you need to find specific CVEs on your targets.

request:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: frontend
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Fedora; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response: HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Length: 490 Accept-Ranges: bytes Connection: keep-alive Content-Type: text/html Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:26:18 GMT Etag: "6ad62810-1ea" Last-Modified: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:24:16 GMT Server: nginx/1.30.6 ﻿ Dashboard de videojuegos
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Fedora; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' 'http://frontend:80'
